name: Yojamba Isle
summary: On Yojamba Isle, Zandalari emissaries seek champions to face horrors awakening in Zul'Gurub. Their camp lies off Stranglethorn Vale's northwestern coast, near the waters leading to Westfall, and calls on Horde and Alliance alike.

sections.title: The Emissaries of Zandalar
sections.body:
The Zandalar Tribe keeps an uneasy peace on Yojamba Isle, though most trolls in Stranglethorn Vale are hostile to outsiders. As priests and lorekeepers of troll civilization, the Zandalari have watched the Gurubashi trolls of Zul'Gurub turn to Hakkar the Soulflayer.

A fully summoned blood god threatens the world, so the Zandalari have traveled far from their ancestral home to establish a staging ground. They call on capable adventurers from either faction to help curb the danger.

sections.title: Guarded Waters
sections.body: Yojamba Isle lies northwest of the Vile Reef and the haunted ruins along the mainland beaches. Ironclad Cove's massive hidden sea-gate lies to the north, and wandering sea beasts frequent the shallows. Though its position is precarious, the Zandalari camp offers a quiet refuge. Exotic rituals, sacred altars, and ancient knowledge give solace and power to those preparing to march into the jungle's darkest ruins.

faq.q: Why are the trolls on Yojamba Isle friendly?
faq.answer: The Zandalar Tribe are priests and historians revered by trolls. They have come to stop Hakkar the Soulflayer in Zul'Gurub, and need champions from both the Horde and the Alliance to help.
Yojamba Isle lies in the far northwestern sea of Stranglethorn Vale, just off the coast northwest of the Vile Reef. It sits near the maritime boundary where the southern sea borders Westfall.

faq.q: What is the Zandalar Tribe doing out here?
faq.answer: The Zandalar Tribe has established a forward camp to watch Hakkar the Soulflayer's dangerous resurgence in Zul'Gurub. From Yojamba Isle, its emissaries recruit, supply, and reward powerful adventurers willing to enter the ancient troll city and defeat the corrupted priesthood before Hakkar's full power is unleashed upon Azeroth.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, you meet the ancient ancestral root of troll civilization. Its traditions, prestige, and demands command deep cultural reverence.
As an Alliance adventurer, you may be startled to find a peaceful troll encampment so close to Westfall. The Zandalari set politics aside before the cataclysmic threat of the Soulflayer.
